helpHint.message: Getting started, features, and common questions.

helpIntro.message: Quick reference for shortcuts and actions. See the GitHub guide below for full details.

fullGuideDesc.message: Comprehensive guides, complete shortcut cheat sheets, and illustrations.

helpStartBody.message:
• Open palette: Click the icon or press shortcut (current: $1).
• Customize: Go to Settings → Keyboard to rebind shortcuts.

helpSearchBody.message:
• Unified search: Type keywords or pinyin to find tabs, bookmarks, and commands.
• Open: Enter opens in current tab; Command+Enter (Win: Alt+Enter) opens in new tab.
• Smart habits: Frequently used items rank first; press Shift+Backspace to forget.

helpAddressBody.message:
• Go to URL: Type a domain or localhost to show “Go to URL”; Enter opens directly, Command+Enter opens in a new tab.
• Web search: Quick Google search when there are no local matches or prefixed with google.

helpControlsBody.message:
• Actions menu: Press Cmd/Ctrl+K or click Actions in the footer for quick options (copy URL, pin, mute, close).
• Keyboard: Navigate with arrow keys or Ctrl+P / Ctrl+N; Tab switches controls.

helpBackBody.message:
• Going back: Press Esc or click back to step back; Esc closes at the main search.
• Trackpad: Two-finger swipe horizontally to step back or close.

helpTabsBody.message:
• Batch cleanup: Palette stays open when closing or muting tabs, protecting pinned tabs.
• Native groups: Search a group name to collapse, rename, or close the group.
• Tab Switcher: Rapidly switch between recent tabs.

helpTuckBody.message:
• Tuck away tabs: Collapse idle tabs into an end group; search anytime to restore.
• Auto tuck: Optionally tuck long-idle tabs automatically when idle.

helpStorageBody.message:
• View website storage: Search local storage, session storage, or cookies to inspect key-values safely (read-only, does not modify data).
• Copy & Permissions: Press Enter to copy values. Reading cookies requests permission only for current domains, revocable anytime (Cookie revocation).

helpShortcutBody.message:
• Shortcuts: Rebind shortcuts in Settings → Keyboard if there is a conflict.
• Ctrl+Tab: Search “ctrl tab” for a quick one-time setup guide.

helpWindowBody.message: • Overlay & Window: Shows an overlay on normal pages, and opens a companion window on restricted Chrome pages.

helpPrivacyBody.message:
• 100% Local: No tracking or telemetry; search habits and website storage remain strictly local.
• GitHub & Docs: Visit our GitHub repository for full documentation and updates.
